text: No, not all days of the period were checked for thermal detections on this property. The first run (run-2) indicates that all days from October 1, 2026, to October 8, 2026, were covered by all sensors (VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS). However, the second run (run-1) shows that only days from October 1, 2026, to October 7, 2026, were covered, with October 8, 2026, not covered due to the latest NRT file update not being published yet. Therefore, the period was not fully checked for thermal detections.
